architecture.mechanism: Ndot control with anti-windup design and bumpless transfer
architecture.intervention: Implement an Ndot-based throttle controller with cascaded filters and anti-windup logic to prevent fuel command overshoot when the accelerator pedal is released during deceleration.
architecture.expected_effect: Consistent deceleration without unintended acceleration or vibration during throttle release transitions.
architecture.falsification_test: Simulate rapid pedal release during deceleration on a 2020 Subaru Forester engine model with deteriorated sensor conditions; verify that engine RPM decreases monotonically without transient spikes exceeding 5% of idle speed.
